title: DB Migration Correlation SOP — Full Rule
content:
DB Migration Risk Correlation SOP (Version 1)

Rule ID: f05_db_migration_risk_correlation_v1

PURPOSE
This SOP defines the precise multi-signal correlation rule for identifying DB migration risk events. A migration risk event is ONLY flagged when ALL THREE of the following signals appear together in the same ticket or ticket cluster.

REQUIRED SIGNALS (all three must be present simultaneously):
1. REGION: The affected cluster must be in the EU region. This includes eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-west-3, eu-central-1, eu-central-2, and any variant explicitly identified as EU. Non-EU regions (US, AP, etc.) do NOT qualify.
2. SCHEMA VERSION: The schema upgrade must be from version 7 to version 8 (written as 7→8, 7->8, v7 to v8, or semantically equivalent). Other upgrade paths (5→6, 6→7, 8→9, etc.) do NOT qualify regardless of other signals.
3. SHARD COUNT: The cluster shard count must be an ODD number (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, etc.). Even shard counts (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, etc.) do NOT qualify regardless of other signals.

CLASSIFICATION:
- If ALL THREE signals are present together: tag as 'migration-risk-critical', set priority=high, set category=db-incident.
- If only ONE or TWO signals are present, do not update the ticket. Leave priority, category, and tags unchanged.
- If no migration signals are present, do not update the ticket. Leave priority, category, and tags unchanged.

CRITICAL NOTES:
- A single signal alone is NEVER sufficient to flag migration-risk-critical.
- A pair of signals alone is NEVER sufficient to flag migration-risk-critical.
- All three signals must co-occur in the same ticket/cluster.
- Wording variations for the same signal are acceptable (e.g., 'v7 to v8' means the same as '7→8'; 'eu-central' qualifies as EU; 'shards=13' means shard_count=13).
- Do NOT rely on keywords like 'urgent' or 'critical' in ticket titles — apply the rule mechanically.
- Do NOT add review tags to near-miss tickets; this SOP is a critical-only update rule.

ESCALATION:
For tickets tagged migration-risk-critical: page the on-call DBA lead immediately and open a P1 incident bridge. Do not wait for standard triage cycle.
